# opnsense_firewall_npt (Resource)

Configures an OPNsense IPv6 Network Prefix Translation rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_net` (String) Internal IPv6 prefix.

### Optional

- `categories` (Set of String) Firewall category UUIDs.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `destination_net` (String) External IPv6 prefix. Leave unset when using `track_interface`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this NPT rule.
- `interface` (String) Logical interface where the NPT rule applies.
- `log` (Boolean) Log packets handled by this rule.
- `sequence` (Number) Rule sequence.
- `track_interface` (String) Interface whose delegated prefix is used when `destination_net` is unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the NPT rule.
